Hello where can i get the stock firmware bin file for the Bitfortun bs2? Thanks
Sent from my iPhone
Searched the web · Bitfortune BS2 miner stock firmware download
Searched the web · bitfortun BS-2 firmware github
Searched the web · Harlo OS Bitfortun BS-2 support harlolabs
Handed to the team · I couldn't find a public BS-2 stock image. BitFortun's GitHub repo (liaojinguu/b

Hello,

Thanks for getting in touch. I looked and couldn't find a public download of the BS-2's stock firmware.

BitFortun has published firmware on GitHub, but it's
firmware for the Bitfortun BS-1 home Bitcoin miner (ESP32-S3 + BM1373)
. It covers only the BS-1 board, and the repository has no release files to download yet. The BS-2 is a different board
running two BM1373 chips
, with its own voltage regulator layout. Please don't flash the BS-1 image onto it. Firmware made for another board can leave the miner unable to start.

Harlo OS also doesn't cover the BS-2 yet. Our Harlo OS page lists the
Bitfortun BS-2, BS-4, Magic M. 40T
 as coming.

I've passed your request to JD, our hardware lead, so he can find the right stock file for the BS-2. The team picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to you by email in this thread. If you reply with the firmware version your unit shows now and why you need the stock file, he can send exactly what fits. For example, tell him whether the unit won't boot or whether you're switching back from other firmware.

You may get an answer faster on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . Mention @nullhashrate (that's JD). He and the community are very active there.

Best regards, Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hello,

Sorry to hear about the toy accident. A few things to clear up below, so you can tell which of these a part will fix.

First, a correction to my last email. Harlo OS isn't an option for either miner at the moment.
Harlo Labs has paused Harlo OS on every miner until further notice and is working on an alternative. It is not offered or installed on any miner for now.

For your Hammer DC06, Hammer publishes the firmware on GitHub. Their repository is HammerMiner/DC06-APP at https://github.com/HammerMiner/DC06-APP/releases . The newest release I found there is V3.0.1-20261012, and its notes say it
optimize[s] mining pool-side algorithm matching
. That said, if the toy physically cracked or broke the screen, new firmware won't fix it. On the DC06, a broken screen is usually solved by replacing the screen while the rest of the miner stays as it is.

To find out whether it's only the screen, please reply with three things. First, does the DC06 still power on: do the fans spin and do any lights come on? Second, does it still show up as a device on your router, or is it still sending work to your pool? Third, please send a clear photo of the damage. If it's still mining with a dead screen, a new screen should be all it needs. If it won't power on at all, the damage may go deeper, and the photo will help us tell.

For the BS-2, there's still no public stock firmware file. Please don't load the BS-1 file or any other model's firmware onto it. Could you also tell me what's wrong with the BS-2 itself? Was it hit too, or did something else happen, like a failed update or a blank screen?

I've passed your request for a DC06 screen and a BS-2 screen with stock firmware to the team, along with the firmware question. The team picks this up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer will come to you by email in this thread. If you send the photos and details above before then, they'll have everything they need.

You can also ask on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention @nullhashrate. That's JD, our hardware lead, and he and the community are very active there.

Best regards, Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
